description: Lifetime Evidence component on a log scale. Floor and cap match the Tier 1 and Tier 6 thresholds, so each tier is worth 20 points.
PREPAREDNESS metric component. Higher is always better to Congress, Overextended included. The floor is the top of the Fragile tier.
Percentage of successful missions over a window of recent budget cycles. The threshold is a soft floor, not a hard minimum, so a strong input can still make up for it.
